reasons: The Agreement contains no insurance clause and TrueLink is a hosting/processing vendor, so the 'missing' classification is correct and an insertion is the appropriate remedy.

Inserted language tracks the playbook preferred position precisely (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M for a vendor processing Client data, workers' compensation, certificates on request, term plus one year) and imposes the obligation solely on the counterparty, creating no burden on us.
Placement in the miscellaneous tail immediately after Section 30 (Force Majeure) follows the redline guidance; the original paragraph text is left untouched, so the edit is minimal.
Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural, cites the playbook limits and offers the sanctioned fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M).

Minor nit only: the inserted heading reads 'INSURANCE.' without the '31.' section number referenced in the rationale; the numbering should be added for consistency with the surrounding numbered headings, but this does not affect substance.
